result: No remaining material defect found in the reviewed screenshot-transport and audio-finalization increment. This is a bounded source review and retained implementation-test audit, not native capture or live audio verification.

source.audio_integration: Reviewed origin delta and combined formatting delta: runtime.rs and runtime_audio_tests.rs only wrap expressions; audio.rs is byte-identical.

source_checks.assessment: Each viewport owns at most 16 exact tokens. Screenshot extraction preserves unrelated clipboard actions. Overflow and dropping an unsubmitted owner are explicit terminal traces.

The native borrowed queue survives absent render state/window/surface, recreation failures and acquisition skips. The production caller passes its actual window. Compatibility by-value API remains available.
Tokens transfer after Queue::submit returns only when the submitted encoder contains the copy. An empty fallback queue submission or a pre-submit unwind does not acknowledge a capture.

Readback retains request tokens into map_async, traces map/format/delivery errors, and marks readiness only after mapped pixels are decoded. No image or automatic resubmission is synthesized on those failures.
One UUID is carried through request-local finite diagnostics, ROOT-only event matching and the saved PNG receipt. App repaint scheduling advances the one request without timer resends.

Existing same-byte bounded PNG validation remains; receipt acceptance additionally requires exactly one matching requested/copy-submitted/readback-ready trace and no ROOT fixture terminal failure. UUID-mismatched or child events cannot satisfy the request.
Legacy and native-v2 run separately once, native-v2 remains scheduled after a legacy step failure unless the job is cancelled, and artifacts retain separate set results.
Stop closes the callback gate, takes both native owners before either stop, attempts both and combines errors while dropping the owners. System callback checks the same gate inside packet splitting.

Capture-loop/stop/device/metrics/drain errors are combined. Finalization caps packet drain at 128, reports the first excess source/sequence, continues past malformed packets and delivery failures, then finishes both endpoints.

An ASR error requests acquisition stop but later queued finals are still attempted with source/segment context. Failed transcript delivery breaks and drops the receiver before capture-thread join, allowing blocked final sends to disconnect explicitly.

upstream_boundary.independent_archive_comparison: All 10 retained upstream implementation/manifest/README files compared directly with the cached pinned crate archive: seven unchanged, exactly capture.rs/lib.rs/winit.rs differ, matching patch metadata. Cargo.lock and .cargo_vcs_info.json packaging metadata are not vendored.
upstream_boundary.licenses: Local MIT and Apache-2.0 full texts match recorded hashes; license scope is provenance inspection, not legal assurance.
upstream_boundary.unchanged_scope: No crate version increase. Immediate-child screenshot capture remains unsupported; Web and Glow painters remain separate.

workspace.independent_source_validation: Retained before/after maps are equal; every one of 354 file hashes matched Git blob bytes at the combined commit. This audit used the retained maps, not unavailable wrapper memory.

normal_build.limit: Build result/log binding checked; no evaluator launch or native execution.

preserved_failure.outcome: Reached requested, then timed out at 30 seconds without a PNG/receipt. No retry. Old failure cause remains unclassified; unknown visibility does not establish that it was hidden.
preserved_failure.resolution_scope: The patch repairs a source-confirmed pre-submit token-loss boundary. No new native result is scored in this source review and a later pass cannot erase the old failure.

limitations: Evaluator performed read-only source, Git, hash and retained-log analysis only; no Cargo/tests, executables, native windows, capture, OS input, credentials, network, audio playback, model construction or inference.
Headless queue/submission and fake-source tests do not prove real GPU surface/map behavior, native driver stop completion, callback timing or lossless dual-source shutdown.
The packet budget reports excess as undelivered; OS stop/drop latency itself is not proven bounded by this change.
New native captures require their separate actual artifact audit. No reference/pixel/font/OS blur/focus or ASR quality/live-route parity claim.
